impact: Mild chip strength supports MU and DRAM into CPI, which is expected at +0.3% m/m after September's +0.6%.
summary: Sanmina jumped 19% premarket on an above-consensus outlook and Take-Two rose 4% on a fiscal Q2 beat; Hims & Hers fell 2% on weak guidance. Nvidia rose 1.3% after hitting a seven-month low Monday, Micron and Marvell were about 1% higher, and S&P and Dow futures rose as oil cooled.
title: Premarket: Sanmina up 19%, Take-Two up 4%, Nvidia and Micron edge up
